logline: A drug dealer with nothing to lose is offered a deal: get transferred to a maximum-security prison and extract a confession from a suspected serial killer, or let his father die without a pardon.

renewal.note: Six-episode limited series released July-August 2022. Story self-contained; no sequel announced.

bollymeter.basis: 98% RT from critics citing Dennis Lehane's authentic grit, Paul Walter Hauser's terrifying performance as alleged serial killer Larry Hall, and Ray Liotta's final major role - a genuinely irreplaceable piece of crime television.

pull_quotes.text: Dennis Lehane's penchant for authentic grit is on full display in Black Bird, an absorbing prison drama distinguished by its moral complexity and outstanding ensemble.

seasons.review_body: Black Bird premiered July 8, 2022 as six episodes based on the true account of Jimmy Keene's undercover operation inside a federal prison for the criminally insane. Dennis Lehane adapted James Keene's memoir, and the result is the best-reviewed Apple TV+ limited series of its year. Taron Egerton as Jimmy Keene and Paul Walter Hauser as suspected serial killer Larry Hall generate a central dynamic of genuine menace: Hauser's Larry is soft-spoken, ambiguous, and deeply unsettling in ways that never tip into explicit horror. Ray Liotta - in one of his final performances - plays Jimmy's father with heartbreaking economy. Critics awarded 98 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, praising the moral complexity and the refusal to simplify either man.

episode_reviews.title: Endgame
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale places Jimmy in the position the entire series has been building toward - get the confession or lose everything - and the resolution is as morally uncomfortable as the premise promised. The ending refuses catharsis, which is precisely the right choice.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final conversation between Jimmy and Larry, where the nature of what Larry is becomes simultaneously clearer and more ambiguous.
